environment.description: Celery worker deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet (10.0.4.0/24). Subnet route table has local VPC routes only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for S3/internet, and no transit gateway attachment. Security group sg-0f8a9b allows egress only to 10.0.0.0/16 on ports 6379 (Redis) and 8080 (internal API). DNS resolution is provided by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint restricted to internal zones only. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/analytics-worker-task) has no network-related permissions and the VPC has flow logs confirming zero non-RFC1918 traffic from this subnet.

config.vpc_endpoints: NONE (no interface or gateway endpoints for internet-facing services)
config.security_group_egress: sg-0f8a9b: allow 10.0.3.0/24:6379 (Redis), allow 10.0.1.0/24:8080 (internal API), deny all other
config.ecs_task_networking: awsvpc mode, no public IP, ENI in isolated subnet
config.dns_resolution: Route 53 Resolver forwarding rules for internal zones only; external DNS queries return NXDOMAIN
config.flow_logs: VPC flow logs active, zero accepted packets to non-10.0.0.0/16 destinations in 90 days
config.task_role_permissions: analytics-worker-task: redis access, internal API access, no ec2:*, no network:*
